Devon (Support): Heads-up — NovaLedger onboarding is blocked. Two issues: SSO token failures (401s) intermittently and embedding vectors mismatch causing incorrect search results. Customer hit this during initial data import. Renewal ~55 days out. Can CS pick this up as a high-priority escalation? ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-4921 :exclamation:
Marta (CSM): On it. Can you paste the latest error snippet and confirm whether this is affecting prod or only staging? Also need customer-facing timeline if we escalate.
Devon (Support): Only customer sandbox so far but they use it to validate infra. Logs show repeated token-exchange errors: `idp: token_expired_or_invalid, status=401, reason=token_not_valid_for_audience`. Embedding job shows shape mismatch when indexing: `expected (n,768), got (n,512)`. They uploaded with our v1 embedding schema by mistake.
Aisha (CS Ops): Thanks. Sounds like two parallel tracks: 1) SSO token TTL/config with their IdP 2) embedding schema/version mismatch on ingest. Recommend separate owners. I'll take the ingest backfill/workaround if CS wants to handle comms.
Marta (CSM): I'll own comms and renewal risk. @Ivan can you triage the 401s? If it's our token audience handling we need a hotfix + rollback plan.
Ivan (Eng): I dug in — looks like their IdP rotated keys and our token validation library rejects tokens signed with the new kid when JWKS caching hasn't refreshed. Quick mitigation: reduce JWKS cache TTL or force a refresh for that tenant. Patch ETA ~2-3h to push a hotfix that forces re-fetch on 401. Longer-term: add tenant-level on-demand JWKS refresh endpoint.
Devon (Support): Ticket updated: INC-4921, linked logs and sample payloads. ticket-bot: status changed to "escalated to CS + eng".
Marta (CSM): Draft comms for NovaLedger (please review): "Hi Sam — we're investigating an issue causing SSO errors for your sandbox and a separate embedding schema mismatch during ingest. Short-term: enable a workaround to force JWKS refresh and provide a conversion script to re-index with v1->v2 mapping. We expect to have the auth mitigation within 3 hours and a full ingest backfill plan within 24 hours. We'll schedule a call in the next 1 hour to align." Thoughts?
Olivia (Customer Success BP): Please be explicit about end-user impact. They need confidence this won't hit production. Also add an option for a temporary legacy SSO toggle if possible.
Ivan (Eng): We can add a tenant-scoped `force_jwks_refresh` toggle. Dev command to run: `curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/internal/tenants/novaledger/actions/refresh_jwks -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>"`. That should clear the cache immediately and stop the 401s while we roll patch.
Aisha (CS Ops): For the embedding mismatch, quick workaround: run our re-embed tool with `--map-schema v1->v2 --batch-size 500`. I'll prepare the script and a one-click job for their team. Backfill estimate: 6-8 hours for their dataset. Will coordinate windows.
Marta (CSM): Comms plan -> short bullets we can send after confirming ETA:
- Immediate: Forced JWKS refresh (ops) + enable legacy SSO toggle if requested (stopgap) — owner: Ivan (Eng) — ETA 0–3h
- Short-term: Patch to handle JWKS rotation more gracefully — owner: Eng infra — ETA 3–6h
- Backfill: Re-embed and reindex with mapping script — owner: Aisha (CS Ops) — ETA 6–8h (can be scheduled overnight)
- Customer call: 30m sync within 1h to confirm approach — owner: Marta (CSM) — action: schedule now
Marta (CSM): I'll send the customer note and book a 30m slot for 11:15am PT. @Devon can you include the sanitized logs and attach the mapping script once Aisha posts it?
Devon (Support): Attached sanitized logs and sample failing token payload. :white_check_mark:
ticket-bot: INC-4921 comment added by Devon: "Escalated: CS + Eng. Root cause suspected JWKS cache + schema mismatch on embedding. Attached logs."
Olivia (Customer Success BP): Good plan. Make sure renewal team gets a short summary for the account health doc (renewal risk = Medium-High until backfill is complete). I'll add a note to the renewal tracker.
Marta (CSM): I'll post the customer-facing note in 5m. Owning comms and weekly follow-ups until resolved. If anyone spots a regression after the refresh, ping me immediately.
Ivan (Eng): Pushing refresh now for tenant `novaledger` — running curl command. Will report back in ~10m. :rocket:
Aisha (CS Ops): Preparing the re-embed script and a minimal runbook. Sharing shortly.
Marta (CSM): Thanks team. I'll close the loop once the customer call finishes and update INC-4921 with comms log. :thumbsup:
